summary: Sleevy is a native-first read-later app. Save any URL to your queue, organize items with folders and tags, and manage read state from web, iOS, a Chrome extension, Raycast, and a REST API.

sleevy_api_key.label: Sleevy API Key
sleevy_api_key.setup: Sign in at https://sleevy.app, open **Settings**, and create a personal API Key under **API Keys**. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` on every request. Keys are scoped and rate-limited per key, and can be revoked from the same screen.
